title.narrative: FCDO Global Fund Accelerator: MedAccess-Global Fund Facility

description.narrative: MedAccess will assess the suitability and impact of volume guarantees (VGs), intermediated guarantees, and other innovative financing tools across HIV, TB and malaria diagnosis, prevention, and treatment commodities, based on barriers to access, market projections, cost analyses, and partner perspectives. MedAccess will progress prioritised opportunities through its deal development process and will ultimately seek to execute transactions that improve value for money for Global Fund procurement and catalyse access to life-saving HIV, TB, and malaria products.

activity-date.narrative: "1) Deal Development: conduct in-depth research and engage partners to analyse the supply- and demand-side landscape, assess barriers to access, evaluate the suitability of a volume guarantee or other innovative financing instruments, and project the development impact and risks of a financing proposition. 2) Deal Execution: work with partners to define the target deal structure, including guaranteed volumes, price, and tenor, undertake due diligence, prepare demand forecast scenarios, impact projections and risk assessments, and conduct negotiations with counterparties to develop, finalise and execute legal agreements for each transaction. 3) Implementation: identify and engage implementation partners and work closely with suppliers and partners to minimise risk and maximise impact for each transaction."
